title: Preterm Birth Detection using EHG Signals
description: An interpretable machine-learning pipeline using MFCCs, wavelet statistics, spectral features, and denoising to classify term and preterm pregnancies. The work also includes a dedicated biomedical acquisition device.

title: Soil Composition & Texture Classification via MSI
description: A field-deployable 13-band reflectance imaging system and ML framework for estimating clay, silt, and sand composition and classifying USDA soil texture.

title: Microcystis Cell Count & Toxicity Estimation
description: Multispectral regression models for rapid harmful algal bloom detection, cell-count estimation, and toxicity assessment.

title: Feature-Conditioned Diffusion for Audio Generation
description: Extending DiffWave with signal-processing features and evaluating conditioning strategies for improved audio generation quality.

title: Soil Moisture Estimation via Multispectral Imaging
description: A reflectance-based multispectral imaging system with deep-learning models for scalable agricultural water-stress monitoring.

title: Non-Invasive Blood Glucose Sensor
description: A wearable prototype combining optical sensing and signal-processing techniques to estimate blood glucose without skin penetration.
